releases.body:
## The game

- **The HUD shows up on every planet.** On Kerwan and other planets the HUD was drawn underneath the world and never seen; on Rilgar it flickered with the ocean. It now draws on top everywhere, on both discs.
- **Quit Game works.** After quitting from the pause menu, the controller stopped responding and the main menu came back with empty buttons. Both are fixed.

releases.name: v0.7.2
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **More of the game behaves like the original.** The last of the code that every planet runs has been checked against the original game, and what differed is fixed:
  - Novalis: an object was missing most of its behaviour (only its first step existed).
  - Aridia: a marker blinked to the wrong clock.
  - Carrying things: the pull was smoothed out where the game keeps it sharp.
  - A few effects and objects on Eudora, Gaspar, Hoven, Gemlik, Oltanis and Novalis.

releases.name: v0.7.3
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **Vector maths that could go wrong in place.** The game's fast cross product (used for movement, aiming, collisions and effects everywhere) gave wrong results when it wrote its answer over one of its inputs. It now matches the original exactly. This was found by running the original game's code side by side with ours on real calls from play.

## For contributors

- 47 of the port's non-matched functions in the main program are now proven to behave exactly like the original on…

releases.name: v0.7.4
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **No more crash after finishing Veldin on Windows.** The cutscene leading into Novalis stopped the game on Windows: one of the game's calls handed its numbers over in an order Windows reads differently. Every call like it is fixed.
- **The US disc behaves much more like the original.** A pass over the code every US planet runs, checked against the US game itself, fixed about 25 places that still used the PAL version's values: sine and cosine, the 2D drawing that the HUD and menus…

releases.name: v0.7.5
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **Two crashes fixed on the PAL disc.** Hitting a crate on Kerwan, and a crash after some camera moves, no longer stop the game.
- **More of the game is the original code.** The latest work from both decompilation projects is in: the PAL game is now 93.95% matched, and dozens more functions on the US disc are decompiled.
- **Video options in the in-game pause menu.** Options during gameplay now includes a Video page with the same rows as the title menu (Resolution, Fullscreen,…
